maya: Hey, I hit a blocker on the embeddings docs PR. The preview is up but reviewers flagged two different examples for how 'inputs' shape is interpreted. Can someone from runtime confirm the canonical behavior?

ci-bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview-503.docs.redwood.ai — checks running.

sanjay: Short answer: server expects items: [item, item, ...]. Each item may be a string or an array of strings (we join array-of-strings into one text with a single ASCII space between parts). The response returns one embedding per item.

maya: Thanks. The PR had an example showing nested arrays (e.g., [["a","b"],["c"]]) to illustrate complex batching; reviewers said that might be invalid.

sanjay: Correct — we do NOT accept nested arrays (arrays of arrays as an item). That will yield a 422.

tess: Also flagging an edge case: what happens when the concatenated text is empty? previously some clients saw an empty vector but that's been changed.

sanjay: We changed that. If after concatenation the text length is zero, we return 400 with a short error payload. Use this exact example in docs for the error cases:
```json
{"error":"empty input","status":400}
```

maya: And the 422 shape error example text? Need exact message to copy into the PR.

sanjay: Use this JSON body for the 422 case:
```json
{"error":"unsupported input shape: nested arrays are not accepted; each item must be a string or array of strings","status":422}
```

tess: One more nuance: we preserve any leading/trailing whitespace on parts, then we join with a single space. So ["Hi ", "there"] -> "Hi  there" (note double space). If docs want to recommend normalizing, suggest calling .strip() in examples.

maya: Good call. I'll add a python snippet showing .strip() before joining. Also will remove the nested-array example.

ci-bot: CI checks found a doclink broken in the example: /api/embeds -> should be /v1/embeddings.

maya: Fixed link in PR and pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5034. I updated the examples to show single-embedding behavior, added the two error snippets (400 & 422), and a short note on whitespace handling.

deploy-bot: Preview redeployed for PR 5034: https://deploy-preview-5034.docs.redwood.ai (:white_check_mark:)

tess: Reviewed and left two tiny copy edits, nothing blocking. Removing hold.

maya: Thanks — merging once final CI passes.

deploy-bot: PR 5034 merged to main by maya. Changelog entry added. :tada:
